title: Where, How, and When: Query-Guided Grounding for Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.21422v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding video content requires reasoning at multiple levels of granularity, from identifying objects to interpreting their interactions and localizing when specific actions occur. This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks that answer where key objects are (object-level grounding), how they interact (relationship-level grounding), and when specific moments occur (moment-level grounding). For object-level grounding, we present QDETRv, a query-guided extension of the Detection Transformer for one-shot localization of unseen objects in videos, which combines query-context fusion, a memory module for temporal consistency, and unsupervised pretraining on synthetic object trajectories. We further propose the Temporal Object-Aware Vision Transformer (TOViT) for few-shot video object detection, which builds on a language-aligned open-set vision encoder and propagates high-confidence object features across frames. translated_title: “何处、如何与何时：面向视频理解的查询引导定位”
translated_abstract: 理解视频内容需要在多个粒度层次上进行推理，从识别物体到解释它们的交互，再到定位特定动作发生的时刻。本论文研究了三个查询引导的定位任务，分别回答关键物体在哪里（物体级定位）、它们如何交互（关系级定位）、以及特定时刻何时发生（时刻级定位）。在物体级定位方面，我们提出了 QDETRv，这是检测Transformer的一个查询引导扩展，用于视频中未见物体的一次性定位，它结合了查询-上下文融合、用于时间一致性的记忆模块，以及在合成物体轨迹上的无监督预训练。我们进一步提出了用于少样本视频目标检测的时序物体感知视觉Transformer（TOViT），它构建于语言对齐的开放集视觉编码器之上，并在帧间传播高置信度的物体特征。对于关系（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本论文围绕视频理解提出物体级、关系级和时刻级三个查询引导定位任务，并引入QDETRv和TOViT等模型分别解决视频中未见物体定位与少样本视频目标检测问题。
en_tdlr: This thesis studies three query-guided grounding tasks for video understanding—object-level, relationship-level, and moment-level—and introduces models such as QDETRv and TOViT for one-shot localization of unseen objects and few-shot video object detection.
